_comment: Mara Voss confronts V moments after the black box is opened (Act 3).
Subtitle text lives HERE, next to the character who says it, not in strings.json:
a scene reads as a script, and splitting the words from the speaker makes it
unreviewable. strings.json stays the home of journal/UI text, which uses a
completely different id namespace (LocKey vs locstring ruid).
Every line and option needs a stable 'id' - tools/alloc_subtitle_ids.py maps it
to a locstring ruid, append-only, and tools/gen_subtitles.py emits the lookup
resource the engine reads.
'actor' on a line names someone in the cast below and becomes that line's speaker.
It stays optional: Hot Fuzz leaves 17 of its 22 lines unset (0xFFFFFFFF) and sets a
real speaker on the other 5, so a scene plays either way - but an unset speaker has
no nameplate and nobody to look at, which is most of what an actor is for.
The addressee is filled in automatically as the other party in a two-hander, which
is how Hot Fuzz's set lines read. Add "to": "<name>" to a line to override it.
Why TWO entry points, same as scene_decision.json (D14): the fourth micro-choice
quotes Mara's own journal back at her, so it may only be offered to a player who
read the shard. The obvious expression is a questCondition on the option, and no
extracted scene ships a non-null one - rule 8 makes that a TODO, not a design. So
the branch lives in the .questphase instead, where rule 1 wants quest logic: the
graph's route_mara reads ashcache_journal_read and enters at mara_meet_in or
mara_meet_in_journal. Same player-facing result, only proven machinery.
The two openings are not the same lines twice. On the journal path she can SEE the
shard in V's hands, which is why she opens defensive and short - and why the fourth
option has any ground to stand on.

scene._categoryTag: scnSceneCategoryTag. Ash Cache is a SideQuest; the Undermine template shipped 'vendorsOpenWorld' only because it was cloned from a vendor scene.

_actors: Character ids from source/characters.json, in the order their actor ids are assigned. Each becomes a scnActorDef: a spawn instruction that puts that TweakDB record at its world marker when the scene starts and takes it away when the scene ends. V is never listed here - the player is appended automatically as a scnPlayerActorDef holding the LAST actor id, matching both reference scenes.

nodes._comment: Locks V in place for the confrontation and holsters the weapon. Tier3_LimitedGameplay is the first rung that actually stops movement - Tier2 keeps ordinary locomotion and only caps speed - and it is what 215 vanilla scenes use. Tier4/Tier5 would hand the camera to a cinematic camera this project does not animate. Paired with 'tier_off'; if you delete one, delete both, and see the INT/RET wiring in quest_graph.json.

Mara cannot be killed, by the player or by the FIA cleanup, and the protection is deliberately NEVER released - which is why there is no matching Mortal node. All 211 vanilla scenes that set mortality do release it; this one does not, because she has to survive past the end of the quest. 'source' names this claim so releasing some other system's protection cannot release hers.

lines.en-us: Don't turn around. That case in your hands has my name in it, under six layers of somebody else's.
lines.ua-ua: Не обертайся. У кейсі, що в тебе в руках, є моє ім'я — під шістьма шарами чужих.

lines.en-us: I'm the one who put it in that wall. Nine years ago. Spent every one of them hoping nobody'd be stupid enough to dig it back out.
lines.ua-ua: Це я замурувала його в ту стіну. Дев'ять років тому. І всі ці роки сподівалася, що ніхто не буде настільки дурним, щоб його викопати.

lines.en-us: Congratulations. Hale's already moving. We've got twenty minutes, maybe.
lines.ua-ua: Вітаю. Гейл уже виїхав. У нас хвилин двадцять, не більше.

options.en-us: Then start talking. What's in the box?
options.ua-ua: Тоді починай говорити. Що в кейсі?

options.en-us: You're FIA. That's all I need to know.
options.ua-ua: Ти з ФІА. Більше мені знати не треба.

nodes._comment: The journal-path opening. Three lines like sec_open, and deliberately not the same three: she can see the shard, so the beat she spends on 'I am the one who hid it' in sec_open is already spent - V read it. What she buys with the saved line is the admission that she left her own name lying around, which is the crack the fourth option widens.

lines.en-us: Don't turn around. And don't palm that shard - I can see the read light from here.
lines.ua-ua: Не обертайся. І не ховай той шард — я звідси бачу індикатор зчитування.

lines.en-us: Nine years I kept that case inside a wall, and I left my own name lying on a desk. That's what nine years does to you.
lines.ua-ua: Дев'ять років я тримала той кейс у стіні — і залишила власне ім'я лежати на столі. Ось що роблять із людиною дев'ять років.

lines.en-us: Hale's already moving. Twenty minutes, maybe. Ask me fast.
lines.ua-ua: Гейл уже виїхав. Хвилин двадцять, не більше. Питай швидко.

nodes._comment: The same three options as 'hub' plus the journal confrontation. The ids carry a '_j' because a locstring ruid is allocated per option id and two hubs cannot share one - the same reason scene_decision.json's hide hub suffixes '_h'. The three shared options route to the SAME sections; only the openings and the fourth branch differ.

options.en-us: Then start talking. What's in the box?
options.ua-ua: Тоді починай говорити. Що в кейсі?

options.en-us: You're FIA. That's all I need to know.
options.ua-ua: Ти з ФІА. Більше мені знати не треба.

options.en-us: Your journal doesn't say "it". It says "she".
options.ua-ua: У твоєму щоденнику не написано «воно». Там написано «вона».

nodes._comment: The break. Every other route to trust is Mara deciding how much to tell V; this one is V catching her in the gap between what she writes down and what she says out loud, and her not being able to close it. It ends on the same trusted/choice_made pair as the others - breaking her is a WAY of earning her, not a fifth disposition.

lines.en-us: Four hundred readings. You get to know a voice.
lines.ua-ua: Чотириста прочитань. Голос починаєш упізнавати.

lines.en-us: I told myself I was preserving evidence. I was keeping her company.
lines.ua-ua: Я казала собі, що зберігаю доказ. Насправді я складала їй компанію.

lines.en-us: So which is it. Evidence, or a person?
lines.ua-ua: То що ж це. Доказ чи людина?

lines.en-us: If I say person out loud, then I should have done something about it nine years ago. So I say case. Say it long enough and you can sleep.
lines.ua-ua: Якщо сказати «людина» вголос — виходить, дев'ять років тому я мала щось зробити. Тому я кажу «кейс». Кажи так досить довго — і зможеш спати.

lines.en-us: You've got the same choice I had, V. And a lot less time. Don't spend nine years on it.
lines.ua-ua: У тебе той самий вибір, що був у мене, Ві. І значно менше часу. Не витрачай на нього дев'ять років.

lines.en-us: A prediction. Grown off a Cynosure scan — yours, if the timestamps aren't lying. It knows what you do next.
lines.ua-ua: Прогноз. Виріс зі сканування Кіносюри — твого, якщо мітки часу не брешуть. Він знає, що ти зробиш далі.

lines.en-us: That's what Hale wants. Not the tech. The certainty.
lines.ua-ua: Ось чого хоче Гейл. Не технології. Впевненості.

lines.en-us: And you?
lines.ua-ua: А ти?

lines.en-us: I want it gone. But I don't get to choose. You do.
lines.ua-ua: Я хочу, щоб його не стало. Але вибирати не мені. Тобі.

lines.en-us: Fair. I'd say the same in your place.
lines.ua-ua: Справедливо. На твоєму місці я б сказала те саме.

lines.en-us: So I'll keep it short. That case predicts you. Hale is coming for it. Do what you like with both of those.
lines.ua-ua: Тоді коротко. Цей кейс передбачає тебе. Гейл їде по нього. Роби з цими двома фактами що хочеш.

lines.en-us: Honest question. I like it better than the other one.
lines.ua-ua: Чесне питання. Воно мені подобається більше за попереднє.

lines.en-us: My cut is I stop waking up at three in the morning. That's the whole price.
lines.ua-ua: Мій зиск — я перестану прокидатися о третій ночі. Ось і вся ціна.

lines.en-us: It grew off your own Cynosure scan, V. It predicts you. Hale wants that more than he wants me breathing.
lines.ua-ua: Він виріс із твого власного сканування Кіносюри, Ві. Він передбачає тебе. Гейл хоче цього більше, ніж хоче бачити мене живою.

_comment: D121. The last thing she does on every route that did not tell her to get
lost, and the answer to the question this scene used to leave hanging: in
forty seconds Hale's crew arrives, and Mara - who has been standing here
warning V about exactly that - does nothing about it. She stood through the
whole firefight like a coat rack.
She does nothing because she cannot, she knows she cannot, and she says so
while handing over the one thing that would have helped. That turns an
engine limitation (her character record is a non-combat scene NPC with no
weapon and no archetypeData - see the _enemies note in characters.json)
into the most in-character moment she has.
The gun itself is granted by the GRAPH, not here, for the reason D120 gives
for the ending item removals: every grant in this quest lives on the other
side of a scene exit where the re-entry guards can see it. The scene says
she hands it over; the graph is what puts it in the backpack.
'Keep your phone on' is a setup with a payoff six seconds into the next act
- ac_msg_mara_01 is her keeping this promise while V is being shot at.

lines.en-us: Before you go. Take this.
lines.ua-ua: Поки не пішов — візьми.

lines.en-us: That's a Liberty. Federal issue.
lines.ua-ua: Це ж «Ліберті». Федеральний зразок.

lines.en-us: Nine years under my coat. I've drawn it twice. Both times at a range, both times badly.
lines.ua-ua: Дев'ять років під пальтом. Діставала його двічі. Обидва рази в тирі — і обидва рази погано.

lines.en-us: I'm no good in a firefight and I'm not going to stand here pretending otherwise. What I'm good at is that clinic's node. By the time Hale's people file a report, you were never in this building.
lines.ua-ua: У перестрілці з мене толку нема, і я не вдаватиму інакше. На чому я знаюся — то це на вузлі цієї клініки. Поки люди Гейла складуть рапорт, тебе в цій будівлі ніколи не було.

lines.en-us: Keep your phone on. I'll count them for you.
lines.ua-ua: Тримай телефон увімкненим. Я їх для тебе порахую.

_comment: D121. The hostile route's counterpart to sec_gift, and the only place the
intimidate branch has ever had a consequence of its own: ashcache_mara_hostile
was set and then read by nothing.
She does not argue, does not plead, and does not withhold the one thing she
can still do for someone who just told her she was nothing but her agency.
Taking V's name off the sign-in on the way out is the same act she performs
on the trusted route - she simply does not get to be thanked for it. That is
the characterisation: the help is not a reward for being nice to her.
No gun. A present is a present; she is not buying anyone.

lines.en-us: Understood.
lines.ua-ua: Зрозуміло.

lines.en-us: I'll be in the back, on the clinic's node, when they get here. Don't come looking for me.
lines.ua-ua: Коли вони приїдуть, я буду в підсобці, біля вузла клініки. Не шукай мене.

lines.en-us: Your name's on the clinic's sign-in. I'm taking it with me on the way out. Not for you — so they can't have it.
lines.ua-ua: Твоє ім'я — у журналі відвідувань клініки. Я заберу його, коли йтиму. Не заради тебе — просто щоб воно не дісталося їм.

nodes._comment: The intimidate branch's counterpart to fact_trusted. facts.json has always said this fact is set by micro-choice B, and until now nothing set it: the hostile path ran straight to fact_made, so the cleanup encounter had no way to know V had told an FIA agent to get lost. OI-1 depends on being able to tell - when hostile she is not in the fight at all.

Set on the journal route only, and set ALONGSIDE fact_trusted rather than instead of it - facts.json has always read 'micro-choice A, or C' for trusted and 'micro-choice C only' for break. Whatever eventually tells the two apart (her behaviour in the cleanup, an epilogue line) needs both bits: broke her is a kind of trusted, not an alternative to it.
Hands full control back. forceEmptyHands 0 lets V draw a weapon again. Mortality is NOT restored here - see 'protect_mara'.
